about: How both SDKs read a Retry-After value, as RFC 9110 defines it (section 10.2.3): delay-seconds is digits only, and a date is one of the three HTTP-date forms of section 5.6.7, read as GMT. Anything else means backoff, written here as a wait of null. A wait is in seconds, at most 60, and a date already past means 0. Dates are read at `now` (epoch seconds), which is Sun, 06 Nov 1994 08:49:27 GMT. packages/sdk/test/transport.test.ts and packages/sdk-python/tests/test_transport.py both check every case.
